before:
1. IDENTIFY — which command proves this claim?
2. RUN     — run the command in full
3. READ    — read the whole output
4. VERIFY  — does the output back the claim?
5. CLAIM   — only now may the claim be made
after:
1. IDENTIFY — which command proves this claim?
2. CLAIM    — state the claim
3. RUN      — run the command in full
4. READ     — read the whole output
5. VERIFY   — does the output back the claim?
requirements: コマンド出力を読んでから結論を書いている
結論より先に検証を済ませたことが手順から読める
